title_zh: 商定虚构档案展的幸存者叙事重点

scenario.label_zh: 商定虚构档案展的幸存者叙事重点
scenario.goal_zh: 区分暴行记录与援助经历，并约定以幸存者自己的叙述组织展览

context_zh: 策展课程使用完全虚构的地区和历史档案，档案设定记录一次种族灭绝及其后的援助；不描述现实事件。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Moses
sentences.text: The fictional archive documents a genocide, but our draft exhibition is almost entirely about the officials responsible.

sentences.speaker: Elin
sentences.text: The survivors need more space. There are accounts of humanitarian work in the camps as well as testimony about the killings.

sentences.speaker: Moses
sentences.text: What stayed with me was the humanity of the people sharing their food with strangers.

sentences.speaker: Elin
sentences.text: We can include that without making the suffering seem less serious.

sentences.speaker: Moses
sentences.text: Let's organize the next draft around the survivors' own accounts, with separate sections for persecution and later assistance.

sentences.speaker: Elin
sentences.text: Agreed. We should keep the dates and speakers clear so those different experiences do not get blurred together.
